correctness.rationale: The 14-vertex generalized Petersen graph GP(7,2) has 21 edges, no triangles, diameter3. Its inclusive scale2 Rips clique complex has precisely 245 nonempty faces by dimensions (14,63,105,56,7). We independently replayed the 68 actual codimension-one free-face collapses from certificate.json and verified no other coface at each deletion, leaving a 2-dimensional complex with (14,51,44), Euler characteristic 7. The original graph generates the scale2 π1: every extra distance-two edge is homotopic to a 2-edge original path. An independently checked spanning tree has exactly eight fundamental non-tree loops, four of graph length5 and four length6; the scale2 Rips complexes of C5 (contractible) and C6 (S2) are simply connected, so each loop is nullhomotopic in the ambient scale2 Rips complex. Hence π1=0; Euler characteristic and freeness of H2 yield Z6, and integral Hurewicz plus homological Whitehead give wedge6 S2. Scale1 wedge8 S1, scale3 full simplex; all real radius thresholds inclusive. Neither mod2 ranks nor finite test alone establishes the integral homotopy.
